title: Construction of Tolosa, San Victor, Tabontabon Road, Tanauan, Leyte
description: CONSTRUCTION OF TOLOSA - SAN VICTOR - TABONTABON ROAD, TANAUAN, LEYTE
colour_meaning: Check: not scored, but a tested “looks fine on paper” pattern.

reasons.title: Total budget above 95% of similar works (length not stated)
reasons.detail: Official budget ₱144.8M; the 95th percentile for Other road project is ₱144.8M (1680 past contracts).
reasons.evidence: Used only when the length cannot be read; a weak sign.
checks: Find the length or quantities in the bid documents and compute the price per km.
Check whether the scope (several roads, bridges, drainage) explains the size.

reasons.title: One bidder, winning bid near the price ceiling
reasons.detail: low-competition pattern: one bidder, winning bid 100.0% of the official price
reasons.evidence: Not linked to termination, but to more citizen complaints (about 1.5 times the odds).
checks: Check how long the tender was advertised and whether requirements were unusually strict.
Check whether the same firm wins this office's contracts repeatedly.

reasons.title: The winner's other projects drew citizen reports
reasons.detail: JELM CONSTRUCTION CORP. has 2 other DPWH projects reported by citizens (ghost/defective/unfinished tags)
more: JELM CONSTRUCTION CORP. has 2 other DPWH projects reported by citizens (ghost/defective/unfinished tags)
reasons.evidence: A contractor whose other roads drew 2+ citizen reports had about 4.5 times the odds of a report.
checks: Open the winner's reported projects on the DPWH Transparency Portal and read what citizens reported.
Plan a site visit or ask a local monitor (Bisto Proyekto, TAPAT) to look once work starts.
